connector.name: HAPI MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: HAPI MCP server: Dynamically exposes OpenAPI REST APIs as MCP tools for AI assistants
connector.summary: Hosted over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image hapi-cli:0.6.0. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.com.mcp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.name: HAPI_FQDN
env.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name for the HAPI server (used in MCP tool URLs)

env.name: HAPI_HOME
env.description: Directory path for HAPI configuration and specs. Should be mounted as a volume in Docker

env.name: PROJECT_NAME
env.description: The name of the project/API (alternative to positional argument)

env.name: HAPI_OPENAPI
env.description: OpenAPI spec URL or path (alternative to --openapi flag)

env.name: HAPI_URL
env.description: Backend API base URL (alternative to --url flag)

env.name: HAPI_PORT
env.description: Server port (alternative to --port flag) - this is the internal container port

env.name: HAPI_CORS
env.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins (alternative to --cors flag)

env.name: NODE_ENV
env.description: Node environment (development, production). 'development' enables verbose logging and debugging features.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Authorization token for accessing the MCP server
